mode: two isolated headless Chromium processes over WebRTC through the local signaling stub

steps.message: Host clicked the real Kite3D Play control and reached the game main menu
Host entered a name, created a six-character party, and the party screen released input and pointer lock
Host used Copy Invite and retained the exact generated invite link
Guest opened the copied invite, clicked Play, joined through the real form, and both browsers saw the same roster
Both players used the Ready UI and both browsers showed every ready mark
Host used Start and both browsers entered wave one with combat HUD, two players, and active local input
Opening a screen during play stopped look input, released pointer lock, and Resume restored play input
Keyboard movement changed both local players and each remote browser received the other position change
The guest dropped and automatically reconnected from the same invite with the same player id, token, and roster slot
Host and guest fired through the public input state, each killed an enemy, and both HUDs reflected authoritative health and wave state
One player died, stayed in the match, and spectated the living teammate on both authoritative and HUD state
The living player cleared wave one while the teammate remained down and both browsers entered the same intermission
The living player bought ammunition through the Trader UI and the purchase and scrap total matched on both browsers
Starting wave two respawned the downed player at full health on both browsers
Both players died in wave two and both browsers showed the same two-player scoreboard instead of leaving the party
Return to Party kept the code and roster and reset every ready mark
The same host started a second match with the same guest and party code, without creating or opening another invite
No uncaught page errors or console errors occurred in either active browser
